text:
Dana: Quick postmortem follow-up from the multi-region failover — consolidating action owners, dates, and the recurring-pattern tags so we can report at next game day.

Ethan: Summary: two repeaters — route-reflector election churn causing asymmetric steering, and intermittent snapshot manifest checksum mismatches during restore.

Priya: I'll take the incident-labeling + weekly digest task to make patterns visible. Will add label `failover-repeat` and enable a Monday digest. Due 2026-04-01.

Mark: I'll own the control-plane mitigation for RR election churn: add tie-break health-fallback + faster withdraw on cutover. ETA 2026-04-12. Will include CI regression.

Sana: I'll take snapshot manifest hardening: atomic mark + checksum + object-count verifier and a pre-restore sanity check. Target 2026-04-04.

Dana: Ops: can we reserve a 90-min staging slot next Tue for a combined routing + restore dry-run? @ops-bot

ops-bot: Calendar: staging dry-run reserved 2026-03-31 11:00-12:30 UTC. Invites sent to @oncall, @Mark, @Sana, @Priya.

infra-bot: Incident MR-FAIL-2026-03-28 closed -> follow-ups created: 6. Link: https://incident-tracker/internal/MR-FAIL-2026-03-28.

Priya: Canonical AI list (import to GH Projects; label `dr-followups`):

```
AI-901 | Labeling + weekly digest (failover-repeat)  | owner: Priya | due: 2026-04-01
AI-902 | RR election tie-break + withdraw on cutover  | owner: Mark  | due: 2026-04-12
AI-903 | Snapshot atomic mark + verifier              | owner: Sana  | due: 2026-04-04
AI-904 | Game-day pre-cutover 5m mirror sample         | owner: Dana  | due: 2026-03-29
AI-905 | Staged routing+restore dry-run notes          | owner: Dana  | due: 2026-03-31
AI-906 | Warm-standby cost sketch                      | owner: Ethan | due: 2026-04-05
```

Ethan: I'll produce a warm-standby ballpark (snapshots + minimal compute + replication) and ping finance. Expect note by 2026-04-03.

Mark: I'll add a CI regression that simulates RR elections and asserts path symmetry within 10% over a 2-min window. Tagging @Priya for visibility.

Sana: Snapshot verifier will be a small pre-mark lambda with retries for eventual consistency. Will open GH issue + PR this week.

Dana: For game-day runs, add a gating check: `steer_sample >= 95%` over a 60s window or abort/rollback. I'll draft the runbook snippet.

Priya: I'll retroactively tag matching incidents for the last 45 days and surface the chart in the weekly digest.

ops-bot: Weekly digest scheduled: every Monday 09:00 UTC. First digest: 2026-03-30.

Ethan: Finance ballpark created: ticket CE-4999. Preliminary: ~$5k/mo for snapshot retention + replication + small warm compute. Final due 2026-04-05.

Mark: Blocker note: soft-mirroring is not available on one load balancer in region A; may need a short hardware request. I'll validate today and post an update here if procurement needed.

Sana: Noted; manifest verifier will include a small backoff/tunable retry to handle eventual consistency if we can't change LB.

Dana: Owners — please post a one-line status in this thread if any AI slips past its due date. We'll review progress in DR sync next Thursday.

Priya: ACK.

Mark: PR draft for tie-break changes pushed to `control-plane` repo (WIP).

Sana: Issue + PR links will be posted here when available.

infra-bot: Follow-up checklist updated: 6 open AIs.

Dana: Thanks all. Closing thread for now — reopen if blockers surface.
